principles: Use one operational truth source; do not duplicate supplier, outreach or membership data across parallel systems.
No product becomes direct-sale stock without verified MCQ supply, actual MCQ selling price, fulfilment path and image rights.
Community outreach must follow each forum/group's promotion and trade-posting rules; contribute useful knowledge before selling.
Prefer direct manufacturer partner/dealer routes; use authorised UK trade distributors when direct purchasing is unavailable.

communities.name: What Hi-Fi? Forum
communities.approach: Join as a genuine participant. Use New Member Intro and topic forums; check community rules before commercial posts.

communities.name: The Art of Sound
communities.approach: Good fit because it explicitly has Trade Impressions for dealer/manufacturer offers plus vintage/analogue sections.

communities.name: AVForums
communities.approach: High-volume UK tech/AV community; participate around hi-fi, home cinema and installation expertise; follow forum advertising rules.

communities.name: Head-Fi
communities.approach: Strong headphones/IEM audience; sponsor/deals areas exist. Use only permitted commercial channels.

communities.name: Audiophiles UK. Hi-Fi and Music.
communities.approach: Referenced by What Hi-Fi forum members. Search Facebook for the exact group name and request membership; check admin promotion rules.

communities.name: The Audiophile Man: Hifi and Music
communities.approach: Referenced by What Hi-Fi forum members. Join only after checking current group/admin rules.

communities.name: Brand owner groups
communities.approach: Linn, LS3/5A, Nakamichi and similar owner groups can be useful for specialist/legacy knowledge. Do not spam; answer problems and source hard-to-find parts.

supplier_routes.next_action: Apply/open trade account; confirm dealer/reseller eligibility, pricing, credit, drop-ship and image-use terms.
Open trade account and confirm MCQ reseller permissions/terms.

supplier_routes.route_type: Official UK distributor / channel partner network
supplier_routes.next_action: Contact Shure UK about authorised dealer/channel partner route; use distributor/partner locator.
Apply for trade/reseller account; compare portable/touring stock and terms.
Ask for reseller/dealer onboarding or authorised UK distributor route.
Submit sales enquiry and ask for dealer/trade route suitable for MCQ.
Contact UK sales and request dealer-account criteria; confirm which product categories MCQ can retail.
Register MCQ; confirm accreditation scope, pricing tier and whether relevant audio/home-cinema lines are eligible.
Ask Sony UK which authorised consumer-audio distributor/dealer programme covers MCQ retail. Do not assume Pro portal covers all consumer audio.

supplier_routes.route_type: Direct B2B partner route; Technics category requires confirmation
supplier_routes.next_action: Register MCQ and explicitly ask whether Technics hi-fi is available through the same programme or which UK distributor handles it.
Apply/enquire about Business Partner/reseller eligibility. Direct Apple Business purchasing alone is not evidence of resale permission.
Open reseller/retailer account; request exact brand line card relevant to MCQ and drop-ship/white-label fulfilment options.
Register as trade dealer/installer; confirm line-by-line brand eligibility.
Contact Synthax about becoming an authorised dealer for relevant brands.
